Maria H.: Heads up — staging canary failed on two installer shards. cosign OK but transport rejected with 'manifest TTL mismatch' when pushing to mirror.
Cheng L.: Which shards? any logs?
Maria H.: shards: installer-aaa.tar.gz and installer-ccc.tar.gz. logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/staging/1799123456 (look at transport-error lines)
Kevin T.: TTL mismatch usually means signer epoch vs manifest epoch. We rotated the signer keys last night, some mirrors still refuse older epoch ranges.
Sara P.: Do we pause the remainder of the rollout or just quarantine those shards?
Maria H.: I'd prefer quarantine + targeted republish. Quarantine means mark the two shard submanifests as blocked and don't flip the top-level epoch. That avoids an immediate global rollback.
Kevin T.: Agreed. Proposed steps:
- mark shards quarantined in signing metadata
- rebuild signed submanifests for those shards with current signer epoch
- cosign and re-publish only the submanifests
- push to mirrors and watch acceptance for 30m
- resume canary if green

Example commands (use the signer service):
\`\`\`
signerctl sign --submanifest installer-aaa.json --key-id=signer-2026-03 --ttl=24h
upload-tool put --bucket=offsite-mirror --path=/manifests/installer/v2.3.1-rc1/installer-aaa.json
deploybot promote --manifest=manifests/installer/v2.3.1-rc1 --scope=canary --window=30m
\`\`\`
Cheng L.: deploybot, please hold any further promote actions for v2.3.1-rc1 until we say resume.
deploy-bot: [automated] Rollout hold requested for manifest v2.3.1-rc1 by Maria H. — blocking promotes and scheduled rollouts. :no_entry:
release-bot: Note — republishing submanifests will change checksums. We'll need a short release-note addendum and packaging change window (15–45m).
Sara P.: Who owns re-sign and republish? Kevin can take the signer step, Maria can handle uploads + mirror eyeballing.
Kevin T.: taking signer + re-sign now. ETA 20m. I'll ping when uploads finish.
Maria H.: I'll coordinate mirror acceptance. If mirrors still reject, fallback is to rollback top-level manifest to previous pinned epoch (we should avoid that unless necessary).
Cheng L.: Also add a note to the changelog: "quarantine & targeted submanifest republish due to signer TTL drift" — ops/packaging to approve.
Kevin T.: Done signing and uploaded installer-aaa and installer-ccc. pushing acceptance check: \`mirrorctl validate --path /manifests/installer/v2.3.1-rc1 --targets=mirror-1,mirror-2\`
Maria H.: mirror-1 accepted both, mirror-2 accepted installer-aaa but still pending for installer-ccc. watching.
Sara P.: If mirror-2 lags >30m we escalate to mirror-owner @cheng oncall.
Cheng L.: I'm oncall, will escalate if not accepted by +35m. For now I'm observing.
Kevin T.: mirror-2 accepted after a re-push. All good. Recommend resuming canary for rollout window 45m.
Maria H.: Resuming canary. deploybot, resume promotes for v2.3.1-rc1 and start 45m window.
deploy-bot: [automated] Resuming promote for v2.3.1-rc1 as requested by Maria H. Rolling to canary targets with 45m window. :white_check_mark:
Sara P.: Quick follow-ups:
- add packaging note for ops that signer rotations should include mirror TTL handshake (action: Cheng)
- mark this as hotfix in release notes (action: Maria)
- add a tiny regression test for signer TTL replay to the packaging CI (action: Kevin)

Maria H.: Acked. I'll update release notes now and ping support for customers on dedicated/private who may have polled during the hold.
Cheng L.: I'll draft the signer-handshake doc and add to runbook.
Kevin T.: I'll open a CI PR for TTL replay test.
Maria H.: thanks everyone. closing thread when release notes updated. :thumbsup:
release-bot: Reminder: update changelog before final prod rollout.
